title: Standard ampere ratings for fuses and inverse time circuit breakers, NEC Table 240.6(A)

source.publisher: Eaton (Bussmann series) reproducing NFPA 70-2023 with NFPA permission
source.document: 2023 NEC Code Changes, publication bus-ele-br-11318 ('Reproduced with permission of NFPA from NFPA 70®, National Electrical Code®, 2023 edition.')
source.attribution: Source: NFPA 70 (NEC) 2023, Table 240.6(A), as reproduced by Eaton with NFPA permission — retrieved Oct 2026

notes: Two pulls match (38 values). 10 A was added for inverse time breakers in 2023; before 2023 the smallest standard breaker rating was 15 A.
The fuse-only 'additional standard ratings' sentence is CONFLICTING in the only source (1, 3, 6, 10 and 601 vs 1, 3, 6 and 601). Do not render it.
No 2026 change was seen (CMP-10 Second Draft does not revise 240.6(A)); the final 2026 text was not seen.
